title: Kanom Prawn Wellington
description: A French-inspired dish featuring prawns in a sweet and savory filling, wrapped in a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: In a pan, melt the butter and sauté the prawns until pink and cooked through.
In a bowl, mix together the kanom, tiger, kissed, gooey, and and.
Add the cooked prawns and Thai sauce to the bowl and stir until combined.
Roll out the pastry and place the prawn filling in the center.
Fold the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the Wellington on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
